feeds.title: My Baba Parenting Blog » Pregnancy
feeds.description: My Baba is a parenting blog with expert tips and advice on parenting and pregnancy including guides and reviews of the latest baby kit and style for mums

feeds.title: Midwife and Life
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jenny, I am a qualified Midwife, Blogger and a Mum of 3. I needed a flexible career that used my skills and knowledge but allowed me to work from home. Blogging and offering my services as a Midwife advisor allows me the freedom to do this. Follow this blog as I help you through pregnancy and parenting.

feeds.title: Kicks Count
feeds.description: Kicks Count aims to reduce the UKs shockingly high stillbirth and neonatal death rate by raising awareness of baby's movements.

feeds.title: Maternity Nurse Blog
feeds.description: Maternity Nurse agency is dedicated to finding you the perfect childcare solution. We help parents looking for a little support after the birth of their child and subsequently their long term childcare needs.

feeds.title: Bump 2 Baby Reality Blog
feeds.description: Bump2baby Reality is a group of local antenatal and hypnobirthing practitioners, pregnancy yoga teacher, midwives, health visitor, baby massage instructor, emergency first responders, breastfeeding supporters and mum and dad volunteers. As a group, we care, prepare and support expectant and new parents from pregnancy to those early days of parenting.

feeds.title: London Pregnancy Clinic Blog
feeds.description: London Pregnancy Clinic Blog is your trusted source for expert pregnancy advice. Whether you're a first-time mother or seeking additional guidance during your pregnancy journey, our blog is here to provide you with valuable insights and reassurance. Discover a wealth of knowledge, shared by leading experts, to help you feel informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.

feeds.title: Jelly Belly Blog
feeds.description: Jelly belly has a special focus for mothers recovering from a caesarean birth who still wish to lose their 'jelly belly', enabling them to regain their strength whilst improving energy, posture and shape. Using Pilates based exercises, considerations are made to ensure that each mum is able to perform the exercises safely minimising any pain or discomfort to the tummy area.

feeds.title: The Parent and Baby Coach Blog
feeds.description: Becoming a parent is a challenging time and the challenge does not stop until your babies grow up. At The Parent and Baby Coach, we believe the Parent to be the Expert and therefore are passionate about helping you find solutions to any parenting issues, challenges and goals you may want to work towards in those early years to make your parenting experience a rewarding and positive time for yourself, your partner and your children.
